technical_and_design_decisions: Each SPI (Mesos, Lattice, K8s, CF) will be moved into its own separate repository to decouple development and reduce admin project complexity.
The 'undeployed' status will be implemented as a new enum value across all deployers to replace the current 'unknown' state for streams without deployment context.
A shared interface or abstract class will be used to ensure consistent handling of the 'undeployed' status across all SPI implementations.
Git submodules or monorepo tooling will be used to manage the new repository structure while maintaining backward compatibility.
Unit and integration tests will be updated to cover the new 'undeployed' status and repository structure changes.
assumptions: The existing codebase uses a modular structure that allows for straightforward extraction of SPI components into separate repositories.
All SPI implementations follow a similar pattern, allowing for consistent application of the 'undeployed' status logic.
The development team is familiar with the Spring Framework and the existing SPI architecture.
No major refactoring of core Spring components is required beyond the SPI separation and status updates.
CI/CD pipelines will need to be updated to support the new repository structure, but this is considered part of the development effort.
